test_process_chunk_response_completed: test that _process_chunk correctly handles ResponseCompletedEvent and updates response ID with model metadata
test_process_chunk_delta_event: test that _process_chunk handles delta events without calling the response ID update method
test_process_chunk_invalid_json: test that _process_chunk gracefully returns None when given invalid JSON input
test_process_chunk_done_marker: test that _process_chunk handles the SSE done marker and sets the finished flag
test_async_iteration_no_failure_logging: test that StopAsyncIteration during streaming does not trigger failure handlers in the logging object
